free_tier.stated: 'Mevcut VPS'yi en az 1 ay için sipariş edin veya uzatın' (order or extend an existing VPS for at least one month), then publish an honest review of THE.Hosting and subscribe to its social accounts to receive 'size mevcut sanal sunucunuza ek 30, 14 veya 7 gün' (an extra 30, 14 or 7 days on the current virtual server) depending on the plan tier. notes: Recorded so the next session does not chase it: the Turkish lane's visible 'free VPS' offers are review-for-extension schemes on a paid order, not free capacity. Two adjacent shapes were checked and also fail: Cli>_ (cliopen.com) advertises a starter credit that requires completing billing details and a card verification through Apple, Google or Stripe, and Netlen runs a prize wheel that pays in domain and hosting vouchers against orders. Nothing in the Turkish lane gives an individual a free machine without first paying for one.
